title: What would happen if your body temperature dropped to room temperature and you woke back up?
angle: Explores the astonishing limits of human suspended animation by examining the real-world medical science of deep hypothermia, showing how metabolic shutdown can turn the human body into a state resembling clinical death while leaving the door open for a miraculous recovery.
description: An engaging, scientifically accurate exploration of deep hypothermia, human suspended animation, and the fascinating medical science of metabolic shutdown.
